description: Suggest 3-6 agents for this tenant from what actually arrives: reads the latest N incoming e-mails and messenger messages (default 200), groups them into topics with the tenant's language model and proposes one agent per topic: name, responsibility, reasoning with its share ('23 von 100 Eingängen' — counted by the server, not by the model), 2-3 example items (kind + id), recommended tool rights and whether a matching agent already exists. SUGGESTION ONLY — creates nothing; after a human agreed, provision_agent sets one up. Read-only.

limit.description: How many recent items to read (default 200, min 10, max 500)

name: suggest_agents
